comment: Dr. Kumas is very clear and has so much knowledge. I appreciate how he applied the material through a consulting lens by analysing business decisions. His exams are very long, and the final is hard, but with a lot of studying, it is not on material you haven't seen before. In-class lectures are easy to follow with packets.
Learned a lot. Fair guy and treats you well. Really enjoyed the class and the pace. Highly recommend to take it.

I liked his style of teaching accounting. Very practical and hands-on. Clear expectations. Great real-life examples to tie some of the most difficult accounting topics to corporate life. Highly recommend to take this class even if you concentrate in accounting.

Dr. Kumas is extremely knowledgeable on the highest-level accounting course at Richmond. He's very reasonable and it's pretty clear what you need to do to get an A in the class. However, the lectures are boring, and his teaching style didn't excite me whatsoever. My advice is to run through the packets and practice problems.

Kumas is a great professor and moves his acct class at a really slow pace, good for some but boring for others. He goes into great detail on a lot of topics so as long as you stay focused, you will succeed. His second exam is much more difficult than his first exam, so make sure to study. I'm not the best accounting student but still succeeded.

I LOVE Dr. Kumas. He makes what could be the hardest Acct class a breeze - probably the easiest Acct class I've had, largely due to his teaching methods and how he structures the course. He treats students as peers and understands that they have a life outside his class. Made me WANT to go to class. Cannot recommend him highly enough.

My biggest complaint are Professor Kumas's tests. There are all multiple choice, so when you show your work, you will get no partial credit (I got up to 25 points off from one question wrong). There is no sympathy for the work you put in. Would not recommend -- there are better professors.
He explains and slows down the toughest topics very well. I felt like these topics were some of the hardest accounting topics, but I did not feel as lost as I have been in other courses.

The lectures are very organized and helpful. Not much preparation is needed going into class, but be prepared to be called on multiple times per class. The exams and quizzes are difficult, but he gives you all the material you need. The exam questions are predictable if you complete his practice problems.
I learned so much from his lectures, but it takes so much time and effort to prep for quizzes and exams. Make right choice.

Dr Kumas is a great professor. In class you do examples together that you see on homework and quizzes. He goes through it until everyone gets it. He does go through things pretty fast but you get used to it quickly. Such a nice guy and really cares about his students. Quizzes are partly individual and partly with a group so it's easy to do well.

Probably  the hardest class so far. Dr Kumas is vey structured in going over the materials  You better pay attention to his daily emails and follow the order in the handouts. They are pretty structured and useful.  Fair grader. Learn a lot in this class.

You will be bombarded by emails during the semester.  Obviously one of hardest accounting class at UR, especially the consolidation part. But, prof. kumas makes it enjoyable. He always moves with the entire class and no one is left behind. I admire his style. Hoyle's book is a MUST and he strictly follows it.

Definitely go over his in-class handouts before the tests and you should be fine. New stuff for me and I struggled a lot. But,  he is fair grader. You need to read Hoyle's book prior to every class. Surely take him.
Fun class with lots of group work. Consolidations seem to be the major topic so far.  Strictly follows Hoyle book and lots of reading and work. Not an easy class.

Very well prepared for classes. You need to read Hoyle's book and his handouts before classes. But, super-clear lectures and repeated explanations make it enjoyable.  Seems good so far. Gleim CPA questions are incorporated. Highly recommend him.
One of the best bschool professors I have had. Makes managerial understandable and enjoyable. You will definitely learn in his class. Would take him again.
Very fair grader. Dr. Kumas is a genuinely caring person. He does his best to make managerial accounting enjoyable.

Professor Kumas is one of the best professors in the Business School. He puts amazing effort during lectures to make sure everybody understands the material. Very helpful during office hours and ready to come outside of his office hours if you really need him, especially before exams.  Midterm exams were not that hard, but final is tough.

Richmond is lucky enough to have him. A lot of cases and daily press articles hit our class discussions. His extra materials make accounting fun. As sophomore I decided to major in accounting after PWC reps visit to our class. Kumas really cares for his students. Best prof. in this semester.

As a social science major I truly amazed with dr. kumas and start liking accounting. I did poorly on the first test, but decided not to withdraw since I like the lectures. Cases and real life examples are highlights of the course . dr. kumas invited two guest speakers from pwc and ey, which really leaded me appreciate the business world.

Awesome instructor. Ready to help all the time. Stop by mr. kumas's office. Great advices on career selection. Always enjoyed chatting with him. downsides are 1)too much workload, 3 exams, 11 quizzes and difficult exams. 2) need to sacrifice sleep and party time. 3) keeps you busy all the time. but, worth it and learn too much.

strongly recommend Mr. Kumas if you want to acquire knowledge and learn mix of economics and accounting. Tests are long and hard to finish. Multiple choices are challenging. But, he curves at the end. Highly motivated to teach and hands you high quality class materials which summarizes the text. very useful. Best instructor I had this semester.

Hard tests and run out of time quickly. Be prepared and practice a lot. He does curve. You learn ECON, FIN and ACCT in Prof. Kumas class. Great discussion about daily WSJ news and you love his way. But, not an easy class (11 quizzes and 3 exams ) and you got to study really  almost every week for a test. register for him if you want to learn.

Really nice guy and a good teacher. He makes you understand the subject better definitely, and uses powerpoint (helpful). BUT! Exams are super hard. And long. It's unreal. Quiz every single week too. I studied so much for this class and think it's still hard. So make the right choice people! ;)
VERY STRUCTURED PROF. THE BEST ONE I HAVE THIS SEMESTER. STRICTLY FOLLOWS THE SYLLABUS. DO NOT EXPECT AN EASY GRADE WITH  THIS PROFESSOR AND HE KEEPS YOU STUDYING ALL THE TIME.

Mr. Kumas is an experienced excellent teacher. he provides a lot of handouts, but taking notes is still necessary in my opinion. Exam1 was difficult and long. Lots of quizzes. 12 quizzes keep you studying almost every week for a short in class test. Skip him if you  dont want to study for a test every week.

Awesome Prof. Excellent to teach accounting. However,  materials are not easy, so you need to sacrifice sleep a bit. Tests are difficult and long. Be quick to finish. Lots of quizzes and need to work really hard. Register to another professor if you do not want to study.
